versions.changelog:
geo-report-pdf 2.0.0 — Major upgrade

- Generates professional PDF GEO audit reports using pandoc and Chrome headless—no Python or ReportLab required.
- New features: cover page, customizable color-coded score tables, severity-tagged finding sections, 90-day roadmap, and advanced section page breaks.
- Simple workflow: reads audit report Markdown, extracts metadata, renders styled HTML, and prints to PDF.
- Easily customizable templates and CSS for branding and visuals.
- Improved troubleshooting and CLI options for flexible output (HTML or PDF).
